THE RULE SYSTEM (plain words):
World: a 64 x 64 square lattice with wrap-around edges, each site holding a planar unit spin (an angle). Energy: minus the sum over all pairs of J(r) times the cosine of their angle difference, where every pair interacts with J(r) proportional to 1/r^4 (r = distance), normalised so that the total coupling per site is fixed. Rules: equilibrium Monte Carlo with single-spin updates (one sweep of all sites per step) at inverse temperature beta = 1, from random angles, for 1000 sweeps. Measure the squared magnetisation and the correlation length.
